subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should a consented MCP App `ui/message` request ever be allowed to send `!`-prefixed host-only command syntax through the normal chat composer?
rationale: This is an authority-boundary decision because the PR reuses the chat-send route for sandboxed app input, and the existing slash-only guard does not establish whether bang commands are intentionally permitted.

options.title: Reject bang commands before dispatch
options.body: Treat `!`-prefixed text like slash commands and preserve the PR’s stated plain-conversational-text-only boundary.

options.title: Allow bang commands deliberately
options.body: Accept the expanded command authority only with explicit policy documentation, threat-model rationale, and focused proof that the consent flow is sufficient.

recommendation.title: Reject bang commands before dispatch
recommendation.body: Treat `!`-prefixed text like slash commands and preserve the PR’s stated plain-conversational-text-only boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the bridge and its existing authority safeguards; a Control UI area owner should make or confirm the final policy decision.
